notes: Moov onboarding webhooks (account.*, capability.*, *verification*, representative.*): providers/onboarding/webhook-status.mjs read the older verification.status first and derived onboarding_status with the shared normalizeOnboardingStatus only, so on staging a webhook could store verification_status unverified and drop onboarding_status out of active after a Refresh had set it from Moov's verificationStatus (623404a34, Freedom Adjustment's sandbox account, 2026-10-26). The webhook now reads verification.verificationStatus first (then the business and older status, then verificationStatus and a verification event's status, then the stored value), and treats an account whose four requested merchant capabilities are all enabled as active unless its verification failed or must be resubmitted or the account is disabled, as the Refresh pull does (handlers.mjs accountVerificationStatus / onboardingStatusFromMoov, inlined so the member stays self-contained). The member stays an ADD (live_sha256 null); a read-only production overlay inspect must confirm it before any apply.
